Adjustable.description: One thing an adjustment may change.
Adjustable.title: Adjustable

AgentDetector.description: The failure detector, as a decision reads it.

status.description: What its last health check found.

AgentEvent.description: One event of the print's, as a turn reads it: what it was and when.

id.description: Its identifier, which a later read asks `since`.

kind.description: What kind of event it is.

payload.description:
What it carried, less the snapshots the context states once and the
bookkeeping no decision reads.

AgentHeater.description:
One heater, in degrees Celsius: each reading absent when the printer did not
report it, or reported one outside what a heater can read.

target_c.description: The temperature it is driving towards.

AgentJob.description: The job as it is now.

completion.description: How far through it is, from zero to one, when that was read in range.

error.description: The error it stopped on, when it stopped on one.

file_position_bytes.description: How far into its file the printer has read, in bytes.

print_time_s.description: How long it has been printing, in seconds.

state.description: What the printer is doing with it.

AgentPrint.description: The print a context is about.

state.description: What the printer was last found doing with it.

AgentPrinter.description: The printer as it is now.

bed.description: The bed's heater, when it has one.

DetectorHealthStatus.description: The failure detector's health, as the last check found it.

oneOf.description: It answered its health check.
It did not.

Nothing checks it: no detector health address is configured, or no
check has been made yet.

EffectiveBounds.description:
The envelope intersected with the print's manifest.

This is what context reports, so that the agent can see its own limits
before it asks. Computing one is the supervision core's; this crate declares
the shape and nothing that produces it.

allowed.description: The range each adjustable may be set to, inclusive.

ErrorSource.description: Whose error a job's error is.

oneOf.description: The printer's own message: its firmware stopped the job.
The host's: it lost the line to the printer, or failed in itself.

EventId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one event.
EventId.title: EventId

EventKind.description: The name one kind of event is written down under: lowercase `snake_case`, declared by the domain that owns the event.
EventKind.title: EventKind

Intervention.description:
One adjustment made for a bounded time.

`prior_value` is read from the printer snapshot taken before the change, and
is absent when the printer reported none — in which case expiry restores
nothing and the outcome says so rather than guessing a default.

action_id.description: The action that asked for it.

id.description: This intervention's identifier, minted by the store.

print_id.description: The print it was made against.

prior_value.description: What the printer reported before the change, if it reported anything.

restored_at.description: When the prior value was put back, if it was.

InterventionId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one bounded intervention.
InterventionId.title: InterventionId

InterventionOutcome.description: What became of a bounded change.

oneOf.description: It is still in force.
The prior value was put back.
There was no prior value to put back.
Putting the prior value back failed.
Another intervention replaced it before it expired.

JobError.description: A job's error, and whose it is.

text.description: The error, as the source reported it.

JobManifest.description:
What a sliced job declares about itself and about what may be adjusted.

An adjustable the manifest does not name takes the envelope's own range; a
manifest range wider than the envelope's is narrowed to the envelope's and
the narrowing is recorded on the print. A manifest may only narrow.

allowed.description: The range each named adjustable may take, inclusive.

file_name.description: The file this manifest is about, as the slicer named it.

material.description: The material the job is sliced for.

nozzle_diameter_mm.description: The nozzle the job is sliced for, in millimetres.

sheet.description:
The build sheet the job goes down on, as one of the sheet ids the
server's sheet table names, such as `smooth-pei` or `textured-pei`.

Every start must declare one: a start whose manifest names none is
refused, and no override lets it through. Optional here only so that a
manifest stored before the field existed still loads.

slicer_profile.description: The slicer profile the job was sliced with.

PlanFact.description: A fact of the plan the print's file does not state.

oneOf.description: The file marks no layers.
The file states no final height.
The file labels no extrusion types.
The file carries no estimate of the time left, by the current position.
The file sets no flow factor, by the current position.
The file sets no part-cooling fan speed, by the current position.
The file labels no objects.

No frame of this print is half an hour old with a position to rise
from, so how far the parts should have grown is not known, and no
growth can be judged from frames closer together.

PlanMismatch.description:
A setting in force that the plan at this height says is wrong for what is
being laid.

oneOf.description:
The part-cooling fan is off while the current layer or the few below
it, which a frame shows, bridge or overhang.
The flow factor is well under one while the current layer lays walls.

PrintId.description: A lowercase hyphenated version 7 UUID identifying one print.
PrintId.title: PrintId

PrinterState.description:
The state a source reports a printer or a print to be in.

The `unknown` arm exists so that a state nobody anticipated is recorded
carrying the source's own word for it rather than lost.

oneOf.description: Connected and idle.
Printing, but paused.
Printing.
Cancelling a print.
In an error state.
Not reachable.
A state this vocabulary does not name, in the source's own word for it.

max.description: The highest value the range admits, inclusive.

min.description: The lowest value the range admits, inclusive.

Rise.description:
How far the plan has risen since an earlier frame of this print: the
height a camera should show the parts to have gained since then.

minutes_ago.description:
How many whole minutes before this read that earlier frame was
captured: the latest periodic observation's frame at least half an hour
old.

top_risen_mm.description:
How far the print's highest point should have risen since the position
that frame's job had reached, in millimetres: the rise of every layer
since that lays anything but supports. It is the plate's, not every
part's: a part the plan has finished does not grow with it.

SetValue.description:
One adjustable as the print's file set it at the current position, and as
a change made through this program since then left it.

changed.description:
What the latest change made through this program set it to, when one
was made after the file last set it.

file.description: What the file's own commands set it to, by the current position.

SlicerPlan.description:
What the slicer planned at the print's current file position: the shape
and place of what should be printing, read from the print's own G-code.

These are the slicer's plan rather than an observation: a feature named
here is part of the design at this height, and nothing here says how well
it printed.

at_odds.description: Each setting in force the plan at this height says is wrong.

fan_percent.description: The part-cooling fan speed, in percent.

final_z_mm.description: The final layer's height, in millimetres.

flow_factor.description: The flow factor, one meaning one hundred percent.

layer.description:
The layer the print is in, counting the first as 1; absent before the
first.

minutes_left.description: The slicer's own estimate of the minutes left, at the current position.

object_count.description: How many objects the file lays down; absent when it labels none.

objects.description:
The bed area each object the file lays down covers, unnamed, as
`[x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]` in whole millimetres, in the order of
the file's object numbers.

rise.description:
How far the plan has risen since an earlier frame; absent before any
frame is half an hour old.

types.description:
What the current layer lays material as, in the order the file first
names each: `Perimeter`, `Support material`, `Bridge infill`.

unknown.description:
The facts the file does not state, which are therefore unknown rather
than absent.

z_mm.description: The current layer's height, in millimetres.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
What a supervision turn reads about one print: [`PrintContext`] with each
fact stated once, as it is now, and nothing no supervision decision reads.

The printer and the job are stated here and nowhere in the events; each
event is what it was and when; and asked `since` an event, only the events
newer than it are carried, so a turn that has read the rest is not handed
them again.

bounds.description: The limits in force, so that the agent can see them before it asks.

detector.description: What the failure detector's last health check found.

job.description: The job now, when it could be read.

manifest.description: The manifest, when the print has one.

printer.description: The printer now, when it could be read.

recent_events.description: This print's recent events, newest first, past the one asked `since`.

slicer.description: What the slicer planned at the job's current file position.

title: AgentContext
